messages:
Priya Rao: FYI we're proposing to switch runtime streaming frames from JSON-chunked objects to newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) to reduce parse overhead and improve incremental decode. this will break older SDKs that expect framed json objects. thinking a sidecar adapter on the ingress edge that rewrites NDJSON->framed JSON for legacy clients. thoughts?
Ethan Brooks: NDJSON makes sense perf-wise. can we detect client capability instead of forcing a header? sniff first 2 bytes for `{"` vs `\n`? but sniffing has edge cases (whitespace, BOM). header `Accept-Stream: ndjson` seems cleaner.
Lena Ortiz: header gate preferred. also streaming over websockets vs http chunked matters. sidecar needs to support both transforms (`ndjson\n` -> `[{...}]` style or emit framed messages). keep it stream-preserving to avoid buffering whole response.
Sahil Patel: agree on stream-preserving approach. implement adapter as a thin Go filter using bufio.Scanner split on `\n`. emit legacy frames by wrapping each JSON line in `{"payload": <line>}` and preserving `event` metadata. minimal CPU. we'll also add a small state machine for partial-line frames.
Priya Rao: spec notes: 1) header opt-in `Accept-Stream: ndjson` 2) streaming metadata moved to `meta` per-line in ndjson; adapter must copy `meta` to top-level when synthesizing legacy object 3) expose `x-compat-mode: ndjson-to-framed` in traces for sampling.
Ethan Brooks: KV cache impact: if frame-level keys change, avoid poisoning. do not rewrite cache keys for adapter reads. option: adapter reads from runtime but does not touch cache layer; or store dual entries during grace. dual entries will double storage; prefer read fallback only.
Lena Ortiz: security: ensure sidecar does not unintentionally inflate request body sizes or allow newline injection attacks. validate each line is valid json object before forwarding; if malformed, return 422 with `compat.decode_error`.
Sahil Patel: testing: unit tests for split/merge, fuzz random chunk boundaries, integration test with long-running client that reconnects mid-stream. perf tests: compare p50/p95 latency and throughput with vs without adapter under same load. expected overhead <2% p95.
Priya Rao: rollout plan: feature flag per-tenant `stream_ndjson_optin`. Start with internal tenants, then partners, then public opt-in header, then full cutover after 45 days. add a telemetry spike alert on `compat.adapter.errors > 0.1%` for canary cohort.
Ethan Brooks: logging: emit `compat.adapter.line_transform=1` metric and `compat.adapter.malformed=1`. also log sample of first 5 lines for debugging (redact tokens).
Lena Ortiz: owner approvals: runtime team ok, devex needs to update SDKs with `Accept-Stream` flag docs. make a migration guide snippet for clients showing how to opt-in.
Sahil Patel: rollbacks: disable header routing or flip tenant flag back. sidecar will be behind rollout gate so removing is trivial. also plan a smoke test that connects streaming client and checks framing correctness post-deploy.
